content.text: The audit handlers are event driven and their bus delivery is awaited, so token events can be recorded before the service calls resolve. I’m adding a dedicated token table/repository and hooking member removal into the same audited event path.

The persistence and public type/schema scaffolding are in place. Next I’m connecting token operations, audit events, and removal-triggered revocations, then I’ll check the project’s type constraints and fix any integration issues.
